contexts.text: Sirens wanted to insidiate against me in my sleep; I had a sad dream. Punishing Spirits were suddenly present, who miserably punished them. Described. They found them all, in spite of all their arts. Described. I marvelled that they were so grievously punished; but the crime is enormous, from the necessity of man's being able to sleep in safety, without which the human race would perish. The same thing takes place round other men whom they attempt to assail insidiously in their sleep, though the man is not aware of it... When man sleeps, the Lord guards him most of all. AC 1983. SE 3680. SE 3681. SE 4236. SE 4420.
The third kind of dreams come through the Spirits who are near while man sleeps...
To these angelic Spirits is also entrusted the duty of watching over certain men while they sleep, lest they should be infested by evil Spirits. Described. SE 3181.
They belong to the province of the cerebellum because this is awake in the time of sleep, while the cerebrum sleeps.
Evil Spirits burn to infest and attack man while he sleeps; but he is then especially guarded by the Lord; for love sleeps not.
To lie down and sleep () = a state of tranquillity and security.

I was told, before I went to sleep, that many were conspiring against me... but, being protected by the Lord, I fell asleep without apprehension. But, being awakened at midnight, I was sensible that I did not respire from myself... SE 458.

They who are appointed to involuntary respiration are present with man while he sleeps; for, as soon as he sleeps, the voluntariness of his respiration ceases, and he receives what is involuntary of respiration. SE 496.
To sleep () = to cherish doubt.
Man's state while his exterior thought is lulled, that is, while he sleeps.

He slept () = an obscure state; for to sleep = an obscure state; moreover, sleep, in the spiritual sense, is nothing else; for there is spiritual sleep, while truths are in obscurity... In the degree, also, of such... obscurity, Spirits have sleep.
In which he sleeps () = quiet upon them. To sleep = to quiesce; here, upon the external Sensuous. Explained.
To sleep, and awake = the life of man in the world, which is natural; and his life after death, which is spiritual.
After his work (in that cavern) everyone is allowed to sleep, etc.
(The visitors in Heaven) slept until the morning.
Woman created while man slept. Explained.
That Spirits sleep. Explained.
While I was sleeping... SE 2752. SE 2974. SE 3006. SE 5598.
That love cannot sleep.

I was overcome with sleep in the afternoon. When I awoke, many around me were in sleep, even the Spirits who had wanted to insidiate against me: these also, being overcome with sleep, slept; and so with all who came with the intention to injure me. When they awoke, they said they had slept, and fled away; one saying that he had not wanted to sleep... The Lord alone watches over all, even His enemies, and does them good.

(Thus) evil Spirits are compelled to sleep when with man, and thus cause that man sleeps well even if surrounded by evil Spirits. Otherwise... if not in sleep they would then perceive that they were Spirits separate from the man... When man sleeps and they are awake, they can then know it.
Dreams which they introduced into Spirits who were asleep.

I slept at intervals... and whenever I awoke he was present in his place; for he had no power over those asleep. There were also some Spirits with me who were asleep, and whom also he could not excite...
That even the worst evil Spirits cannot excite those asleep.
They had Subjects with me while I was asleep.
These desire to act while man sleeps.

On a certain one with me who was asleep. - He was in such a sleep that he cared nothing whatever for the infestations of evil Spirits. Such is the sleep of some, that they believe themselves most safe [then] because protected by the Lord. Evil Spirits were then infesting; but they confessed that they could effect nothing.
Some insidiated against me while I was asleep. The punishment. For to insidiate at night against man while he sleeps is an abominable thing, and therefore such draw down a penalty upon themselves.
They could see the ideas I had while I was asleep.
They wanted to know what angelic Societies were with me while I was asleep.
I was with these this night, and I slept there...
While I was awake, the Spirits around me were asleep; (thus) while man is awake, the Spirits around him may be asleep.
Certain then said, from innocence Hush, the Lord is asleep...
Being infested by adulterers while I was asleep, these two aided them.
One who, while I slept, dispersed two Angels, and then assailed me, seizing the genitals with his hand, wanting thus to destroy me...
Certain with me while I was asleep (caused me) to want to kill those who entered into my chamber...
This was done while I slept.
The plane and ultimate is with an intelligent man, whether he is thinking... or is asleep...

Spirits do not know where men are... When they happen to light upon them while they are asleep there appears as it were a sound of shouting outside of them, and as if some one fell down near the bed, and went under it, and stayed there. The man then supposes that it is an illusion, or a vision; but this is the source of it. It has happened to me sometimes while I slept.

On those who have slept much. - A certain person who in the life of the body had slept much, and had had the delectation of his life in it, applied himself to the Spirits with me, and somnolence at once took possession of me. The Spirits also complained. Such are of almost no use, [but are rejected; for they induce a torpor on others so that they cannot think; for thought is of waking, and makes waking.
To sleep = to lead a natural life without a spiritual one. AE 187:end, illustrated. AE 355:11.
As peace is in them and from them, it is said, In peace I together lie down and sleep (). To lie down and sleep = to live.
To sleep () = to live a natural life without a spiritual one. AE 911:3.
To sleep the sleep of an age () = that to eternity they will not perceive truths. AE 601:11.
In this state the Lord appears to be absent, (which) is signified by He was asleep ().
Occurs.
To sleep in the forests () = to be safe from the infestation of evil concupiscences, although among them. AE 701:18.
Those in the pits are signified by them that slept (). AE 899:10.
